ADDENDUM
No. APPSC-1211512024 Dated \taragar, the 23'd August, 2024
In continuation to Commission's Advertisement No. APPSC-
1211512024 dated 8ft August, 2024 for the post of GDMO (Allopathy/Homeopathy/Dental
Surgeon), it is to inform the aspirants that the Hon'ble Gauhati High Court vide its judgement
& order dated 14.08.2024 in WP(C) No.328/2024 -Dr. Ogam Taggu-Vrs-The State of A.P &
Ors. has directed to keep 01(one) post of GDMO (Dental Surgeon) vacant till the frnal
disposal of the case. Therefore, the total post of GDMO (Dental Surgeon) is reduced to 08
(eight) subject to final judgement of the Hon'ble High Court.
The other terms and conditions of the advertisement will remain
unchanged.
(Marto Riba )
